title: Experimenting during the AI MegaJam with different tools
author: daraand
selftext:
I've been randomly curious for using all the tools the MegaJam gave people credits for. I wrote up a a messy notepad txt, apparently that's wrong you need to make MD files, and then just went stream of conscious on everything. Full on absurd mode.

One thing I am doing my best to maintain is creative intent. I write a lot, I playtest a lot, and let it figure out the rest. We'll see how it turns out!

I've been devlogging here: [https://dav01da.itch.io/spaghetti/devlog/1778371/i-think-theres-something-here-its-not-good](https://dav01da.itch.io/spaghetti/devlog/1778371/i-think-theres-something-here-its-not-good)

But really, it is a silly and simple workflow

\- Meshy API key from MegaJam

\- DevinAI CLI uses Claude Opus 5.5 and also it's own AI model for coding agents

\- UE 5.9

\- notepad.exe for stream of conscious making up stuff to journal and then paste into CLI heh

  
This being on a cleaned out machine, I wanted to have CLI do everything. I did install Unreal Engine by hand, but any Visual Studio tools etc, I had the CLI do it.
